# Measured test time of each e2e test binary: whole seconds (rounded up), the
# sum of the JUnit `time` of every test in that binary across the `e2e` shards
# of one green run, keyed by nextest binary id (the JUnit `classname`). A line
# with a test name between the id and the seconds is that one test's own time,
# for each test a shard group in `e2e_shard.py` runs alone.
#
# `e2e_shard.py` sizes its weighted shard groups from this table; a binary a
# group names but this table lacks weighs `DEFAULT_WEIGHT_S`. It steers balance
# only: every archived test still runs on exactly one shard, which
# `seal-slice-cover` proves on every run whatever this table says.
#
# Regenerate after the e2e test set or its timings move: download every
# `junit-e2e-<shard>` artifact of a green run, sum each `<testcase>` `time` per
# `classname`, round up, and keep the per-test lines for the isolated tests.
